action_summary: Reverted the regressions introduced in v30-v32: removed topic downsampling, per-topic SMOTE oversampling and the 4500-feature cap, so LightGBM again trains on the full original training set with the full saved selected-feature list (the configuration that scored 0.8183 in v29, versus 0.8073 now). Fixed the OOF array to be float so fold predictions are no longer truncated, and added an overall OOF QWK printout. Added QWK-optimal rounding: Nelder-Mead optimisation of the five class thresholds on the OOF predictions (multiple starts), used for the test predictions only if it beats plain rounding on OOF. Saved OOF/threshold and raw test predictions to disk for later blending. Submission format and Kaggle paths are unchanged.
